config.//6: (withinclose/WithinCompanyCloseWriter, one per group the company is ACTIVE in).
config.//gap: THIS CONNECTOR WAS MISSING. finance-service has wired an OutboxWriter since the
config.//gap2: group-consolidation work (config/EventsConfig.java) and both writers above have been
config.//gap3: writing rows to finance_service.public.outbox — but with no connector, nothing ever
config.//gap4: relayed them to Kafka. docs/EVENT-CATALOG.md lists both events as live; the transport

config.plugin.name: pgoutput
config.slot.name: finance_outbox_slot
config.publication.name: finance_outbox_pub
config.//table: Capture ONLY the transactional outbox table (rule 3: publish via the outbox).
config.//binary: payload is a bytea column shipped as base64 text via StringConverter; the
config.//binary2: consumer's libs/events Base64ByteArrayDeserializer decodes it back to Avro bytes.
config.//topic: Route to a topic named exactly after the event_type (no prefix), so the value
config.//topic2: lands on e.g. `TrialBalancePublished` — the topic finance's own grouptb listener
config.//topic3: and notification-service's ConsolidationClosed listener subscribe to.
config.//headers: Expose the outbox row id + company_id + traceparent as Kafka headers; the
config.//headers2: consumer dedupes by the `id` header (the durable event id), not by offset (HR-3).
config.//snapshot: `initial` is deliberate here, and differs in EFFECT from the other connectors:
config.//snapshot2: they were registered against empty outbox tables, whereas finance's has been
config.//snapshot3: accumulating unrelayed rows (nothing prunes the outbox). The snapshot therefore
config.//snapshot4: REPLAYS that backlog on first start, which is the desired repair — it backfills
config.//snapshot5: group_trial_balance from every historical close. Safe on both consumers: finance's
config.//snapshot6: grouptb ingest is processOnce-idempotent, and notification-service's sender is the
config.//snapshot7: StubNotificationSender (synthetic receipts, no real email/SMS), so replayed
config.//snapshot8: ConsolidationClosed rows cannot send stale messages to anyone.
